name.en: California State Route 99 — the Central Valley's spine
name.zh: 加利福尼亚 99 号州道（中央谷地的脊梁）

tagline.en: The valley's working freeway, and what is left of US 99
tagline.zh: 谷地的生产性高速公路，也是 US 99 的遗存

start.en: Interstate 5 near Wheeler Ridge, at the south end of the San Joaquin Valley
start.zh: 圣华金谷南端、惠勒岭附近的 5 号州际公路

end.zh: 红崖镇附近的 36 号州道

en: CA 99 runs up the floor of the Central Valley from the Tehachapi end to the top of the Sacramento Valley, threading Bakersfield, Fresno, Modesto, Stockton, Sacramento and Chico. Interstate 5 crosses the same territory forty miles to the west, but it was deliberately routed along the empty west side; CA 99 stayed on the line of the old US 99, which means it goes through the towns rather than past them.

That is the whole character of the road. It is a freeway that serves agriculture, food processing and packing, and its traffic reflects it: a heavy and highly variable share of trucks, local trips mixed with long-distance freight, and a string of interchanges built to different standards in different decades.

South of Sacramento the route is now a continuous freeway. North of Sacramento it never became one, and the road there ranges from four-lane freeway to two-lane rural highway, with parallel SR 70 taking much of the through traffic in places.
zh: CA 99 沿中央谷地谷底，自特哈查比一端北上至萨克拉门托谷北端，串起贝克斯菲尔德、弗雷斯诺、莫德斯托、斯托克顿、萨克拉门托与奇科。5 号州际公路在其以西约四十英里穿过同一片区域，但它当初是刻意选线于人烟稀少的西侧；CA 99 仍沿着老 US 99 的走向，也就意味着它是穿过城镇，而不是从旁绕过。
这就是这条路的全部性格。它是一条服务于农业、食品加工与包装业的高速公路，车流也如实反映了这一点：货车比例高且差异极大，本地出行与长途货运混杂，沿线互通立交则出自不同年代、按不同标准建成。
萨克拉门托以南如今已是连续的高速公路。以北则从未建成，那里的道路形态从四车道高速到双车道乡村公路不等，部分路段的过境车流大多由并行的 70 号州道承担。

en: The number is a remnant. US 99 ran from Mexico to Canada and was decommissioned in California once Interstate 5 took over long-distance traffic; the state route number was assigned in 1964 and the federal designation disappeared in 1972.

The choice that shaped the modern road was made around 1957, when Interstate 5 was aligned along the west side of the valley instead of up the US 99 corridor. That moved the 90 per cent federal funding share away from this route, and upgrading it became a slower, state-funded, piecemeal business rather than a single Interstate programme.

The consequence was an expressway with at-grade intersections in the middle of a fast-growing valley — drivers on cross streets waiting for gaps in near-freeway traffic. Caltrans spent decades closing those crossings. Work on the last one, in Merced County between Chowchilla and Atwater, began on 11 December 2012, and the Plainsburg Road interchange opened on 15 January 2016, completing the conversion of the route south of Sacramento to a freeway of at least four lanes.
zh: 这个编号是一段遗存。US 99 曾自墨西哥通往加拿大，在 5 号州际公路接手长途交通之后于加州境内被撤销；州道编号于 1964 年赋予，联邦编号则在 1972 年消失。
决定这条路现代面貌的抉择大约发生在 1957 年：5 号州际公路选线于谷地西侧，而非沿 US 99 走廊北上。这使 90% 的联邦资金份额移出了本路线，其改造由此变成由州财政支撑、进度更慢、逐段推进的事务，而不是一个统一的州际公路计划。
结果是在一个快速增长的谷地中部，留下了一条带平面交叉口的快速路——横向道路上的司机得等着在接近高速车速的车流中找空档。加州交通局花了数十年逐一取消这些交叉口。最后一处位于默塞德县乔奇拉与阿特沃特之间，工程于 2012 年 12 月 11 日开工，普莱恩斯堡路互通立交于 2016 年 1 月 15 日通车，至此萨克拉门托以南全线改建为至少四车道的高速公路。

en: Caltrans' Route 99 Business Plan is unusually frank about the corridor it describes. Across the 274-mile San Joaquin Valley section, average daily traffic ranged from 42,000 to 165,000 trips when the 2020 report was written, and was projected to reach between 62,000 and 243,000 by 2040.

The truck share is the striking part: between 8.25 and 27.30 per cent of total traffic depending on the segment. That spread — more than threefold — is why route-wide averages are close to useless here and why the plan works segment by segment.

Capacity gaps remain. The 2020 plan identified three gaps in Caltrans District 6 totalling nearly 37 miles, the largest a 25.4-mile stretch from the southern Tulare County line to the city of Tulare, and three more in District 10 totalling 22.2 miles. Safety, the plan says, is still the single most important consideration on the route.
zh: 加州交通局的《99 号公路业务规划》对其所描述的走廊异常坦率。在圣华金谷长 274 英里的路段上，2020 年报告撰写时的日均交通量为 42,000 至 165,000 车次，并预计到 2040 年将达到 62,000 至 243,000 车次。
货车占比最为醒目：视路段不同，占总交通量的 8.25% 至 27.30%。这一超过三倍的差距，正是全线平均值在此几近无用的原因，也是该规划逐段编制的原因。
通行能力缺口仍然存在。2020 年规划指出，加州交通局第六区有三处缺口共计近 37 英里，其中最大的一段自图莱里县南界至图莱里市，长 25.4 英里；第十区另有三处，合计 22.2 英里。规划表示，安全仍是本路线最重要的单项考量。

value.en: 274 miles, the section covered by the Route 99 Business Plan
value.zh: 274 英里，即《99 号公路业务规划》所涵盖的路段

figures.source: Caltrans Route 99 Business Plan Final Report, March 2020

why.en: The published total includes overlaps with US 50 and I-5 in Sacramento, and no clean route figure from Caltrans could be verified this session. The agency's own planning documents work from the 274-mile valley corridor instead.
why.zh: 已公布的总里程包含在萨克拉门托与 US 50、I-5 的共线部分，本次查证未能从加州交通局取得不含共线的全线数据。该机构自身的规划文件改以 274 英里的谷地走廊为准。

value.en: Nearly 37 miles across three gaps in District 6 and 22.2 miles across three in District 10, the largest a 25.4-mile stretch to Tulare
value.zh: 第六区三处缺口近 37 英里，第十区三处 22.2 英里，最长一段为通往图莱里的 25.4 英里

figures.source: Caltrans Route 99 Business Plan Final Report, March 2020

why.en: There is no total. The route was upgraded piece by piece over more than sixty years through separate state and federal programmes, and Caltrans accounts for it project by project rather than as one build.
why.zh: 并无总数。本路线在六十余年间通过多个独立的州与联邦计划逐段升级，加州交通局按项目而非按整条道路核算支出。

value.en: 42,000 to 165,000 trips depending on segment, projected to reach 62,000 to 243,000 by 2040

trafficFigures.source: Caltrans Route 99 Business Plan Final Report, March 2020

value.en: Between 8.25% and 27.30% of total traffic, varying by segment
value.zh: 占总交通量的 8.25% 至 27.30%，各路段不同

trafficFigures.source: Caltrans Route 99 Business Plan Final Report, March 2020

value.en: By 2009 only six miles of the 274-mile corridor lacked median barrier where it was warranted
value.zh: 至 2009 年，274 英里走廊中仅有六英里在应设中央护栏处尚未设置

value.en: Caltrans issues high wind advisories between the Stanislaus/San Joaquin and San Joaquin/Sacramento county lines, advising against travel by campers, trailers and permit loads
value.zh: 加州交通局会在斯坦尼斯劳斯／圣华金县界至圣华金／萨克拉门托县界之间发布大风预警，建议房车、挂车及许可载运车辆不要通行

timeline.en: The state route number 99 is assigned as the state renumbering takes effect.
timeline.zh: 随着州道重新编号生效，99 号州道编号确立。

timeline.en: US 99 is decommissioned in California, its long-distance role taken by Interstate 5.
timeline.zh: US 99 在加州被撤销，其长途运输职能由 5 号州际公路接替。

timeline.en: Caltrans begins work on the last expressway segment with at-grade intersections, in Merced County.
timeline.zh: 加州交通局在默塞德县开工改造最后一段带平面交叉口的快速路。

timeline.en: The Plainsburg Road interchange opens on 15 January, completing the freeway south of Sacramento.
timeline.zh: 1 月 15 日普莱恩斯堡路互通立交通车，萨克拉门托以南全线高速化完成。
